type: AMENDMENT_PROPOSAL - noise-buffered Stage-3 L-rung fit restriction prior to any Stage-3 launch
data_state: Zero Stage-1, Stage-2, or Stage-3 T-38 runs exist at creation.
defect_identified: Under an ideal additive Chinchilla scaling law L(N, D) = E + A * N^-alpha + B * D^-beta with zero multi-epoch degradation, expected 1-to-4-epoch data gain E[BPB_1ep - BPB_4ep] = B * (D_1ep^-beta - D_4ep^-beta) is identical at M and L. Consequently, the unbuffered clause 'drop L iff gain_L < gain_M' triggers 50% of the time by pure seed noise, risking discarding 20.4 GPU-hours of valid Stage-3 L runs.
